name: flypit
description: FLYPIT — a slither pit where the mass is money. Three packages, no workspaces: web/ (Next), server/ (the arena), contracts/ (Hardhat).

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix web install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix contracts install
scripts.test: npm --prefix web run sim && npm --prefix web run smooth && npm --prefix contracts test
scripts.check: npm --prefix web run lint && npm --prefix web run typecheck && npm --prefix server run typecheck
